notes: Caught live on the very first force start: modelTick's remaining_stale still used the TTL formula while candidate SELECTION used the clean-pass definition (fresh_since), so a forced full recompute reported ~0 remaining after its first tick and the runner declared "complete" after 25 names instead of 5,070. The completion signal now uses the SAME staleness definition as selection — a run and its stopping rule must share one notion of done. The start acknowledgment reports the honest universe count for a clean pass, and the regression test drives a two-name clean pass through both ticks to genui
